note: The design chain of custody (ADR-336): ruling (an ADR) -> design master (docs/design-system/master/) -> vendored bundle (docs/design/arp-face/) -> GUI 3 shell (docs/design/gui3*) -> engine (the stub today). One row per ruled design element: its ADR and clause, the lab it came from, the master component and version that hold it, the bundle export when it is not the component's own name, its shell place as `path: needle` (the file must contain the needle; a place on a row below in-shell is a LOCAL drawing, evidence that the shell skipped the master hop ADR-316 forbids), its state, and a note. `superseded_by` marks a ruling a later ADR replaced. `state: unknown` is allowed only with `settle`, the evidence that would decide it: never guess a state. Every ADR in DECISIONS.md has a row or a `not_design` entry with a one-line reason. `labs` gives every lab in the design index its status (tools/gen_lab_index.py shows it); `not_labs` names the index's pages that are not labs. `vendoring.known_drift` records, pinned to the vendored file's sha256, any difference between the vendored copy and vendor(master) that the human has not yet ruled on. Update this file in the same PR as the hop it records. tools/design_chain_check.py (./verify fast) holds all of it to the tree. `component` is a master component or a file of the master tree (README.md, tokens.json, ...); `bundle` is a bundle export or `bundle.css: needle` / `tokens.css: needle`. `via` is null, or `spec` (the element reaches the shell through the generated parameter table, ADR-316) or `seam` (it is the device adapter's own behaviour); only a via row reaches the shell without a master component. `port_tab` names the port ledger row (B593) the element belongs to. Filled by the B596 audit, 2026-10-30.
